theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_fd_fibre_signed_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (s : ℝ) (H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → AEMeasurable H volume → (∀ b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable b → ∫⁻ p : ℝ × ℝ, b p * H p = ∫⁻ x in {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖}, b (‖x‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)) * ENNReal.ofReal (‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure) → (∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ, H p ≠ ∞) ∧ Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (H p).toReal) ∧ (∀ b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, Measurable b → (∃ M : ℝ, ∀ p, |b p| ≤ M) → ∫ p : ℝ × ℝ, b p * (H p).toReal = ∫ x in {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖}, b (‖x‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)) * (‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure) ∧ ∀ s' : ℝ, s' ≤ s → ∫⁻ p in Ioo (1 - s') (1 + s') ×ˢ Ioo (-s') s', H p = ∫⁻ x in {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s' ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s' ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖}, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure
